# Configuration reference

Settings come from defaults, then `config.toml` in the data directory, then `RELAYBAY_*`
environment variables, then command-line flags (a later source wins). An invalid value
stops `relaybay serve` with a message that names the key.

## Settings

| Key (`config.toml`) | Default | Environment | Flag | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| — | `data_dir` in `desktop.toml`, else the per-user data dir (`platformdirs`) | `RELAYBAY_HOME` | `--home` | Data directory: `relaybay.sqlite`, `token`, `config.toml`. |
| `host` | `127.0.0.1` | `RELAYBAY_HOST` | `--host` | Bind address. Anything but loopback prints a warning. |
| `port` | `8765` | `RELAYBAY_PORT` | `--port` | Port. |
| `allowed_hosts` | `[]` | `RELAYBAY_ALLOWED_HOSTS` | — | Extra names accepted in the `Host` header (LAN names); the environment variable is comma-separated. |
| `[stages.labels]` | the stage keys | — | — | Display names per stage (`plan`, `dev`, `review`, `test`, `live`, `done`). |
| `[reports.labels]` | built-in | — | — | Display names of report states and sizes. |
| `[reports.hints]` | built-in | — | — | Tooltips of report badges. |
| `desktop_link_template` | `claude://claude.ai/epitaxy/{id}` | `RELAYBAY_DESKTOP_LINK_TEMPLATE` | — | Link for a desktop session id; must contain `{id}`. |
| `done_window_days` | `7` | `RELAYBAY_DONE_WINDOW_DAYS` | — | Days a done task stays in the done column (whole number >= 1). |
| `require_tracker_log` | `false` | `RELAYBAY_REQUIRE_TRACKER_LOG` | — | Done tasks without the tracker mark show "not logged" and are never archived. Moving to `done` needs the mark: a `Warning (rules)` line, and `rules_mode = "strict"` refuses the move. |
| `owner_names` | `["owner", "me", "you"]` | `RELAYBAY_OWNER_NAMES` | — | Names that mean you in a task's `waiting_on` (case-insensitive): those tasks are listed in the Inbox. The environment variable is comma-separated. |
| `[rules]` | built-in rules | — | — | Global working rules merged over the defaults ([SPEC §6](../SPEC.md#spec-rules)). |
| `rules_mode` | `warn` | `RELAYBAY_RULES_MODE` | — | `warn` or `strict`: what a stage move or a report that misses a rule does. |
| `coordinators` | `[]` | `RELAYBAY_COORDINATORS` | — | Sessions allowed to change the rules directly with `rules_update`: a desktop session id (`local_…`, the call must also pass that session's own `hook_session`), an alias or a name. A guard against mistakes, not access control: all MCP clients share one token. Empty: every change is a proposal. The environment variable is comma-separated. |
| `[permission_defaults]` | `local = "full"`, `test = "full"`, `live = "read"` | — | — | Legacy: agents' level per environment kind (`none`, `read`, `ask`, `full`); a layer under `policy.json` ([policy reference](policy.md)). |
| `guard_mode` | `warn` | `RELAYBAY_GUARD_MODE` | — | Legacy: `off`, `log`, `warn` or `block`, the guard mode; a layer under `policy.json` ([policy reference](policy.md)). |
| `policy_file` | `policy.json` in the data directory | `RELAYBAY_POLICY_FILE` | — | The global policy layer (JSON, [policy reference](policy.md)); a relative path is read from the data directory. A missing file means the `default` preset. |
| `attachment_roots` | `[]` | `RELAYBAY_ATTACHMENT_ROOTS` | — | Extra folders `attach_file` may read screenshots from, besides the project's `repo_path` and the temp folder (for example a screenshots folder). The environment variable is comma-separated. |
| `attachments_max_mb` | `10` | `RELAYBAY_ATTACHMENTS_MAX_MB` | — | Largest screenshot in MB (whole number >= 1). |
| `attachments_task_max_mb` | `200` | `RELAYBAY_ATTACHMENTS_TASK_MAX_MB` | — | Screenshots of one task in all, in MB (whole number >= 1). |
| `plan_reminder_every` | `30` | `RELAYBAY_PLAN_REMINDER_EVERY` | — | Remind a linked agent of its current plan step every this many tool calls (PostToolUse events); 0 turns the periodic reminder off (session start and todo changes still remind). |
| `pulse_stale_days` | `7` | `RELAYBAY_PULSE_STALE_DAYS` | — | Days after which a project's pulse is marked stale (whole number >= 1). |
| `task_stale_days` | `5` | `RELAYBAY_TASK_STALE_DAYS` | — | Days without a change after which `portfolio_digest` lists an open task (whole number >= 1). |
| `digest_budget_chars` | `12000` | `RELAYBAY_DIGEST_BUDGET_CHARS` | — | Default size of a digest in characters, about 3k tokens (500 to 40000). |
| `session_context` | `auto` | `RELAYBAY_SESSION_CONTEXT` | — | `auto` or `off`: whether `SessionStart` adds the task context or a short project digest to the session's context. |
| `session_context_project_chars` | `1500` | `RELAYBAY_SESSION_CONTEXT_PROJECT_CHARS` | — | Size of the project digest added at `SessionStart` (500 to 40000; the hook answer's own limit applies on top). |
| `usage_enabled` | `true` | `RELAYBAY_USAGE_ENABLED` | — | Read token usage from the Claude Code transcripts the hooks report (only `usage` numbers and the model name are kept; no network call). `false` stops the reading and the keeping of transcript paths; the Usage page shows what was read before. |
| `usage_interval_seconds` | `300` | `RELAYBAY_USAGE_INTERVAL_SECONDS` | — | Seconds between passes of the background usage reader (whole number >= 10). |
| `claude_home` | your home directory | `RELAYBAY_CLAUDE_HOME` | `--claude-home` | Folder with Claude Code's `.claude/` and `.claude.json` (setup, doctor, Integrations). |
| `update_check` | `true` | `RELAYBAY_UPDATE_CHECK` | — | Ask GitHub for the latest release (one unauthenticated request, no data sent but the version in the `User-Agent`) shortly after the start and every `update_check_hours`; a newer one shows a line in the Inbox. A failed check is silent. `false` turns it off. |
| `update_check_hours` | `24` | `RELAYBAY_UPDATE_CHECK_HOURS` | — | Hours between update checks (whole number from 1 to 720). |
| `backup_keep` | `5` | `RELAYBAY_BACKUP_KEEP` | — | Backups kept in `backups/` of the data directory; one is taken when a new version starts, before it migrates the database (whole number >= 0; 0 takes none). |

## Example `config.toml`

```toml
port = 8765
allowed_hosts = ["my-laptop.lan"]   # needed only when you bind to a LAN address
desktop_link_template = "claude://claude.ai/epitaxy/{id}"
done_window_days = 7
require_tracker_log = false
rules_mode = "warn"
owner_names = ["owner", "me", "alex"]   # waiting_on values listed in the Inbox

[stages.labels]
dev = "in progress"
done = "shipped"

[reports.labels]
verified = "checked"

[reports.hints]
M = "medium change"

[rules]
guidance = "Ask the owner before anything goes live."
description_template = "Goal:\nWhy:\nDone when:"

[rules.report_format]
sizes = ["S", "M", "L"]

[rules.stage_requirements]
test = [{ kind = "report_since_stage_change" }]
done = [{ kind = "field_present", field = "progress" }]
```

## Desktop program (`desktop.toml`)

`desktop.toml` lives in the per-user config folder (`platformdirs`: on Windows
`%LOCALAPPDATA%\relaybay`, on macOS `~/Library/Application Support/relaybay`, on
Linux `~/.config/relaybay`), or in the folder `RELAYBAY_CONFIG_DIR` names. The program
and the CLI both read it; `relaybay desktop config` shows and changes it. Beside it:
`external-token` (0600, the external server's token), `window-state.json` (the board
window's size, position and maximized flag, written by the program),
`desktop-start.log` (the program's start journal, read by `relaybay doctor`) and the
program's `desktop.lock` and `desktop.ipc`.

The data folder is `--home`, else `RELAYBAY_HOME`, else `data_dir` here, else the
per-user data dir.

| Key | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `data_dir` | unset: the per-user data dir | Data folder (an absolute path) for the program and the CLI when neither `--home` nor `RELAYBAY_HOME` is given. Pointing it at another folder moves nothing. |
| `autostart` | `false` | Start the program at login (hidden, tray icon only). Each start rewrites the entry with the current executable. |
| `server_mode` | `embedded` | `embedded`: the program runs the server itself. `external`: it opens `server_url` with the token in `external-token`, and the CLI (`token`, `hook`, `setup`, `doctor`) talks to that server too; `relaybay serve` ignores it. Plain `http://` to another machine warns: the token travels in clear text. |
| `server_url` | `''` | Base URL of the external server (`http://` or `https://`). |
| `update_check` | `true` | The program asks GitHub for the latest release shortly after the start and every `update_check_hours`; a newer one puts a dot on the tray icon and Update to X.Y.Z in its menu. Settings → Check for updates checks now either way. The server's own check is `update_check` in `config.toml`. |
| `update_check_hours` | `24` | Hours between the program's update checks (whole number from 1 to 720). |
